_comment: Brand palette and display font for generated course markup.
restyle_html.py and courseforge_gui.py read this; override the path with
the CF_BRAND environment variable, or edit these values in place.
This controls what CourseForge WRITES. It deliberately does not control
the component DETECTOR in restyle_html.classify(): that matches the
border colours of the existing MGCCC page template in order to recognise
a hero/card/callout in a body someone already built. Those literals are a
fingerprint of the markup being read, not a style choice, so they live in
the code with a comment rather than here. A different institution
restyling its own existing template needs new detector patterns, not just
new colours - see DETECTOR_NOTE in restyle_html.py.
name: MGCCC

fonts.body: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
